module origen_133954 (
    input [99:0] a,
    input [99:0] b,
    input cin,
    input [15:0] split_input,
    output [15:0] final_output
);

    wire [99:0] sum;
    wire cout;
    wire [7:0] split_high, split_low;

    // 100-bit Carry-Lookahead Adder
    carry_lookahead_adder cla (
        .a(a),
        .b(b),
        .cin(cin),
        .sum(sum),
        .cout(cout)
    );

    // 16-bit Binary Splitter
    binary_splitter splitter (
        .input_data(split_input),
        .high_byte(split_high),
        .low_byte(split_low)
    );

    // Final output module
    assign final_output = {sum[99:92], split_high};

endmodule

module carry_lookahead_adder (
    input [99:0] a,
    input [99:0] b,
    input cin,
    output [99:0] sum,
    output cout
);

    wire [99:0] g, p;
    wire [100:0] c;

    assign c[0] = cin;

    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 100; i = i + 1) begin : cla_logic
            assign g[i] = a[i] & b[i];
            assign p[i] = a[i] | b[i];
            assign c[i+1] = g[i] | (p[i] & c[i]);
            assign sum[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ c[i];
        end
    endgenerate

    assign cout = c[100];

endmodule

module binary_splitter (
    input [15:0] input_data,
    output [7:0] high_byte,
    output [7:0] low_byte
);

    wire [3:0] select;
    wire [15:0] decoder_out;

    // 4-bit decoder
    decoder_4to16 dec (
        .in(select),
        .out(decoder_out)
    );

    // 16:1 multiplexer for high byte
    mux_16to1 mux_high (
        .in(input_data),
        .sel(select),
        .out(high_byte)
    );

    // 16:1 multiplexer for low byte
    mux_16to1 mux_low (
        .in(input_data),
        .sel(select),
        .out(low_byte)
    );

    // Select signal generation
    assign select = 4'b1000; // Always select high and low bytes

endmodule

module decoder_4to16 (
    input [3:0] in,
    output reg [15:0] out
);

    always @(*) begin
        out = 16'b0;
        out[in] = 1'b1;
    end

endmodule

module mux_16to1 (
    input [15:0] in,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] out
);

    always @(*) begin
        case (sel)
            4'b0000: out = in[7:0];
            4'b0001: out = in[8:1];
            4'b0010: out = in[9:2];
            4'b0011: out = in[10:3];
            4'b0100: out = in[11:4];
            4'b0101: out = in[12:5];
            4'b0110: out = in[13:6];
            4'b0111: out = in[14:7];
            4'b1000: out = in[15:8];
            default: out = 8'b0;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
